description.value: Hungry Otters is a street food vendor on King George Boulevard in Surrey, serving an eclectic lineup of hot dogs, samosas, pierogies, and grilled cheese sandwiches. The stall accommodates a wide range of dietary needs, with vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free, and sugar-free options all confirmed. Notably, the vendor accepts Bitcoin payments, making it one of the few street food stops in the region with crypto-friendly checkout.
